translations.web: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

translations.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
translations.ylt: So, then, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live according to the flesh;
translations.web: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

translations.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
translations.ylt: for if according to the flesh ye do live, ye are about to die; and if, by the Spirit, the deeds of the body ye put to death, ye shall live;
translations.web: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

translations.kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
translations.ylt: for as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are the sons of God;
translations.web: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

translations.kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
translations.ylt: for ye did not receive a spirit of bondage again for fear, but ye did receive a spirit of adoption in which we cry, `Abba--Father.'
translations.web: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

translations.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
translations.ylt: The Spirit himself doth testify with our spirit, that we are children of God;
translations.web: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

translations.kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
translations.ylt: and if children, also heirs, heirs, indeed, of God, and heirs together of Christ--if, indeed, we suffer together, that we may also be glorified together.
translations.web: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

translations.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
translations.ylt: For I reckon that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory about to be revealed in us;
translations.web: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

translations.kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
translations.ylt: for the earnest looking out of the creation doth expect the revelation of the sons of God;
translations.web: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

translations.kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
translations.ylt: for to vanity was the creation made subject--not of its will, but because of Him who did subject it --in hope,
translations.web: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

translations.kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
translations.ylt: that also the creation itself shall be set free from the servitude of the corruption to the liberty of the glory of the children of God;
translations.web: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

translations.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
translations.ylt: for we have known that all the creation doth groan together, and doth travail in pain together till now.
translations.web: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

translations.kjv: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
translations.ylt: And not only so, but also we ourselves, having the first-fruit of the Spirit, we also ourselves in ourselves do groan, adoption expecting--the redemption of our body;
translations.web: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

translations.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
translations.ylt: for in hope we were saved, and hope beheld is not hope; for what any one doth behold, why also doth he hope for it?
translations.web: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

translations.kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
translations.ylt: and if what we do not behold we hope for, through continuance we expect it.
translations.web: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

translations.kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
translations.ylt: And, in like manner also, the Spirit doth help our weaknesses; for, what we may pray for, as it behoveth us, we have not known, but the Spirit himself doth make intercession for us with groanings unutterable,
translations.web: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

translations.kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
translations.ylt: and He who is searching the hearts hath known what is the mind of the Spirit, because according to God he doth intercede for saints.
translations.web: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

translations.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
translations.ylt: And we have known that to those loving God all things do work together for good, to those who are called according to purpose;
translations.web: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

translations.kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
translations.ylt: because whom He did foreknow, He also did fore-appoint, conformed to the image of His Son, that he might be first-born among many brethren;
translations.web: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

translations.kjv: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
translations.ylt: and whom He did fore-appoint, these also He did call; and whom He did call, these also He declared righteous; and whom He declared righteous, these also He did glorify.
translations.web: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

translations.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
translations.ylt: What, then, shall we say unto these things? if God is for us, who is against us?
translations.web: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

translations.kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
translations.ylt: He who indeed His own Son did not spare, but for us all did deliver him up, how shall He not also with him the all things grant to us?
translations.web: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

translations.kjv: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifieth.
translations.ylt: Who shall lay a charge against the choice ones of God? God is He that is declaring righteous,
translations.web: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

translations.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
translations.ylt: who is he that is condemning? Christ is He that died, yea, rather also, was raised up; who is also on the right hand of God--who also doth intercede for us.
translations.web: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

translations.kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
translations.ylt: Who shall separate us from the love of the Christ? tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
translations.web: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

translations.kjv: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
translations.ylt: (according as it hath been written--`For Thy sake we are put to death all the day long, we were reckoned as sheep of slaughter,')
translations.web: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

translations.kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
translations.ylt: but in all these we more than conquer, through him who loved us;
translations.web: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

translations.kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
translations.ylt: for I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor messengers, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present,
translations.web: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

translations.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
translations.ylt: nor things about to be, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to separate us from the love of god, that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
translations.web: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

translations.kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
translations.ylt: Truth I say in Christ, I lie not, my conscience bearing testimony with me in the Holy Spirit,
translations.web: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

translations.kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
translations.ylt: that I have great grief and unceasing pain in my heart--
translations.web: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

translations.kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
translations.ylt: for I was wishing, I myself, to be anathema from the Christ--for my brethren, my kindred, according to the flesh,
translations.web: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

translations.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
translations.ylt: who are Israelites, whose is the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the lawgiving, and the service, and the promises,
translations.web: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

translations.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: whose are the fathers, and of whom is the Christ, according to the flesh, who is over all, God blessed to the ages. Amen.
translations.web: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

translations.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
translations.ylt: And it is not possible that the word of God hath failed; for not all who are of Israel are these Israel;
translations.web: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

translations.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
translations.ylt: nor because they are seed of Abraham are all children, but--`in Isaac shall a seed be called to thee;'
translations.web: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

translations.kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
translations.ylt: that is, the children of the flesh--these are not children of God; but the children of the promise are reckoned for seed;
translations.web: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

translations.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
translations.ylt: for the word of promise is this; `According to this time I will come, and there shall be to Sarah a son.'
translations.web: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

translations.kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
translations.ylt: And not only so, but also Rebecca, having conceived by one--Isaac our father--
translations.web: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

translations.kjv: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
translations.ylt: (for they being not yet born, neither having done anything good or evil, that the purpose of God, according to choice, might remain; not of works, but of Him who is calling,) it was said to her--
translations.web: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

translations.kjv: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
translations.ylt: `The greater shall serve the less;'
translations.web: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

translations.kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
translations.ylt: according as it hath been written, `Jacob I did love, and Esau I did hate.'
translations.web: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

translations.kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
translations.ylt: What, then, shall we say? unrighteousness is with God? let it not be!
translations.web: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

translations.kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
translations.ylt: for to Moses He saith, `I will do kindness to whom I do kindness, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion;'
translations.web: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

translations.kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
translations.ylt: so, then--not of him who is willing, nor of him who is running, but of God who is doing kindness:
translations.web: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

translations.kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
translations.ylt: for the Writing saith to Pharaoh--`For this very thing I did raise thee up, that I might shew in thee My power, and that My name might be declared in all the land;'
translations.web: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

translations.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
translations.ylt: so, then, to whom He willeth, He doth kindness, and to whom He willeth, He doth harden.
translations.web: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

translations.kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
translations.ylt: Thou wilt say, then, to me, `Why yet doth He find fault? for His counsel who hath resisted?'
translations.web: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

translations.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
translations.ylt: nay, but, O man, who art thou that art answering again to God? shall the thing formed say to Him who did form it, Why me didst thou make thus?
translations.web: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

translations.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
translations.ylt: hath not the potter authority over the clay, out of the same lump to make the one vessel to honour, and the one to dishonour?
translations.web: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

translations.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
translations.ylt: And if God, willing to shew the wrath and to make known His power, did endure, in much long suffering, vessels of wrath fitted for destruction,
translations.web: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

translations.kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
translations.ylt: and that He might make known the riches of His glory on vessels of kindness, that He before prepared for glory, whom also He did call--us--
translations.web: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

translations.kjv: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
translations.ylt: not only out of Jews, but also out of nations,
translations.web: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

translations.kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
translations.ylt: as also in Hosea He saith, `I will call what is not My people--My people; and her not beloved--Beloved,
translations.web: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
translations.ylt: and it shall be--in the place where it was said to them, Ye are not My people; there they shall be called sons of the living God.'
translations.web: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

translations.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
translations.ylt: And Isaiah doth cry concerning Israel, `If the number of the sons of Israel may be as the sand of the sea, the remnant shall be saved;
translations.web: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

translations.kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
translations.ylt: for a matter He is finishing, and is cutting short in righteousness, because a matter cut short will the Lord do upon the land.
translations.web: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

translations.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
translations.ylt: and according as Isaiah saith before, `Except the Lord of Sabaoth did leave to us a seed, as Sodom we had become, and as Gomorrah we had been made like.'
translations.web: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

translations.kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
translations.ylt: What, then, shall we say? that nations who are not pursuing righteousness did attain to righteousness, and righteousness that is of faith,
translations.web: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

translations.kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
translations.ylt: and Israel, pursuing a law of righteousness, at a law of righteousness did not arrive;
translations.web: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

translations.kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
translations.ylt: wherefore? because--not by faith, but as by works of law; for they did stumble at the stone of stumbling,
translations.web: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

translations.kjv: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
translations.ylt: according as it hath been written, `Lo, I place in Sion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offence; and every one who is believing thereon shall not be ashamed.'
translations.web: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”

translations.kjv: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
translations.ylt: Brethren, the pleasure indeed of my heart, and my supplication that is to God for Israel, is--for salvation;
translations.web: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

translations.kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
translations.ylt: for I bear them testimony that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge,
translations.web: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

translations.kjv: For they being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
translations.ylt: for not knowing the righteousness of God, and their own righteousness seeking to establish, to the righteousness of God they did not submit.
translations.web: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

translations.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
translations.ylt: For Christ is an end of law for righteousness to every one who is believing,
translations.web: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

translations.kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
translations.ylt: for Moses doth describe the righteousness that is of the law, that, `The man who did them shall live in them,'
translations.web: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

translations.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
translations.ylt: and the righteousness of faith doth thus speak: `Thou mayest not say in thine heart, Who shall go up to the heaven,' that is, Christ to bring down?
translations.web: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);

translations.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
translations.ylt: or, `Who shall go down to the abyss,' that is, Christ out of the dead to bring up.
translations.web: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

translations.kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
translations.ylt: But what doth it say? `Nigh thee is the saying--in thy mouth, and in thy heart:' that is, the saying of the faith, that we preach;
translations.web: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:

translations.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
translations.ylt: that if thou mayest confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and mayest believe in thy heart that God did raise him out of the dead, thou shalt be saved,
translations.web: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

translations.kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
translations.ylt: for with the heart doth one believe to righteousness, and with the mouth is confession made to salvation;
translations.web: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

translations.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
translations.ylt: for the Writing saith, `Every one who is believing on him shall not be ashamed,'
translations.web: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

translations.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
translations.ylt: for there is no difference between Jew and Greek, for the same Lord of all is rich to all those calling upon Him,
translations.web: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

translations.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
translations.ylt: for every one--whoever shall call upon the name of the Lord, he shall be saved.'
translations.web: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

translations.kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
translations.ylt: How then shall they call upon him in whom they did not believe? and how shall they believe on him of whom they did not hear? and how shall they hear apart from one preaching?
translations.web: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

translations.kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
translations.ylt: and how shall they preach, if they may not be sent? according as it hath been written, `How beautiful the feet of those proclaiming good tidings of peace, of those proclaiming good tidings of the good things!'
translations.web: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”

translations.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
translations.ylt: But they were not all obedient to the good tidings, for Isaiah saith, `Lord, who did give credence to our report?'
translations.web: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”

translations.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
translations.ylt: so then the faith is by a report, and the report through a saying of God,
translations.web: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

translations.kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
translations.ylt: but I say, Did they not hear? yes, indeed--`to all the earth their voice went forth, and to the ends of the habitable world their sayings.'
translations.web: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”

translations.kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
translations.ylt: But I say, Did not Israel know? first Moses saith, `I will provoke you to jealousy by that which is not a nation; by an unintelligent nation I will anger you,'
translations.web: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”

translations.kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
translations.ylt: and Isaiah is very bold, and saith, `I was found by those not seeking Me; I became manifest to those not inquiring after Me;'
translations.web: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”

translations.kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
translations.ylt: and unto Israel He saith, `All the day I did stretch out My hands unto a people unbelieving and gainsaying.'
translations.web: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”

translations.kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
translations.ylt: I say, then, Did God cast away His people? let it not be! for I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin:
translations.web: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

translations.kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
translations.ylt: God did not cast away His people whom He knew before; have ye not known--in Elijah--what the Writing saith? how he doth plead with God concerning Israel, saying,
translations.web: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

translations.kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
translations.ylt: `Lord, Thy prophets they did kill, and Thy altars they dug down, and I was left alone, and they seek my life;'
translations.web: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”

translations.kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
translations.ylt: but what saith the divine answer to him? `I left to Myself seven thousand men, who did not bow a knee to Baal.'
translations.web: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

translations.kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
translations.ylt: So then also in the present time a remnant according to the choice of grace there hath been;
translations.web: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

translations.kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
translations.ylt: and if by grace, no more of works, otherwise the grace becometh no more grace; and if of works, it is no more grace, otherwise the work is no more work.
translations.web: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

translations.kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
translations.ylt: What then? What Israel doth seek after, this it did not obtain, and the chosen did obtain, and the rest were hardened,
translations.web: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

translations.kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
translations.ylt: according as it hath been written, `God gave to them a spirit of deep sleep, eyes not to see, and ears not to hear,' --unto this very day,
translations.web: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

translations.kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
translations.ylt: and David saith, `Let their table become for a snare, and for a trap, and for a stumbling-block, and for a recompense to them;
translations.web: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

translations.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
translations.ylt: let their eyes be darkened--not to behold, and their back do Thou always bow down.'
translations.web: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”

translations.kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
translations.ylt: I say, then, Did they stumble that they might fall? let it not be! but by their fall the salvation is to the nations, to arouse them to jealousy;
translations.web: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

translations.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
translations.ylt: and if the fall of them is the riches of a world, and the diminution of them the riches of nations, how much more the fulness of them?
translations.web: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

translations.kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
translations.ylt: For to you I speak--to the nations--inasmuch as I am indeed an apostle of nations, my ministration I do glorify;
translations.web: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

translations.kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
translations.ylt: if by any means I shall arouse to jealousy mine own flesh, and shall save some of them,
translations.web: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

translations.kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
translations.ylt: for if the casting away of them is a reconciliation of the world, what the reception--if not life out of the dead?
translations.web: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

translations.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
translations.ylt: and if the first-fruit is holy, the lump also; and if the root is holy, the branches also.
translations.web: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

translations.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
translations.ylt: And if certain of the branches were broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wast graffed in among them, and a fellow-partaker of the root and of the fatness of the olive tree didst become--
translations.web: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

translations.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
translations.ylt: do not boast against the branches; and if thou dost boast, thou dost not bear the root, but the root thee!
translations.web: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

translations.kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
translations.ylt: Thou wilt say, then, `The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in;' right!
translations.web: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

translations.kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
translations.ylt: by unbelief they were broken off, and thou hast stood by faith; be not high-minded, but be fearing;
translations.web: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

translations.kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
translations.ylt: for if God the natural branches did not spare--lest perhaps He also shall not spare thee.
translations.web: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

translations.kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
translations.ylt: Lo, then, goodness and severity of God--upon those indeed who fell, severity; and upon thee, goodness, if thou mayest remain in the goodness, otherwise, thou also shalt be cut off.
translations.web: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

translations.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
translations.ylt: And those also, if they may not remain in unbelief, shall be graffed in, for God is able again to graff them in;
translations.web: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

translations.kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
translations.ylt: for if thou, out of the olive tree, wild by nature, wast cut out, and, contrary to nature, wast graffed into a good olive tree, how much rather shall they, who are according to nature, be graffed into their own olive tree?
translations.web: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

translations.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
translations.ylt: For I do not wish you to be ignorant, brethren, of this secret--that ye may not be wise in your own conceits--that hardness in part to Israel hath happened till the fulness of the nations may come in;
translations.web: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

translations.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
translations.ylt: and so all Israel shall be saved, according as it hath been written, `There shall come forth out of Sion he who is delivering, and he shall turn away impiety from Jacob,
translations.web: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

translations.kjv: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
translations.ylt: and this to them is the covenant from Me, when I may take away their sins.'
translations.web: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”

translations.kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.
translations.ylt: As regards, indeed, the good tidings, they are enemies on your account; and as regards the choice--beloved on account of the fathers;
translations.web: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

translations.kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
translations.ylt: for unrepented of are the gifts and the calling of God;
translations.web: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

translations.kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
translations.ylt: for as ye also once did not believe in God, and now did find kindness by the unbelief of these:
translations.web: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

translations.kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
translations.ylt: so also these now did not believe, that in your kindness they also may find kindness;
translations.web: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

translations.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
translations.ylt: for God did shut up together the whole to unbelief, that to the whole He might do kindness.
translations.web: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

translations.kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
translations.ylt: O depth of riches, and wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
translations.web: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

translations.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
translations.ylt: for who did know the mind of the Lord? or who did become His counsellor?
translations.web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

translations.kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
translations.ylt: or who did first give to Him, and it shall be given back to him again?
translations.web: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

translations.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: because of Him, and through Him, and to Him are the all things; to Him is the glory--to the ages. Amen.
translations.web: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

translations.kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
translations.ylt: I call upon you, therefore, brethren, through the compassions of God, to present your bodies a sacrifice--living, sanctified, acceptable to God--your intelligent service;
translations.web: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

translations.kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
translations.ylt: and be not conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, for your proving what is the will of God--the good, and acceptable, and perfect.
translations.web: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

translations.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
translations.ylt: For I say, through the grace that was given to me, to every one who is among you, not to think above what it behoveth to think; but to think so as to think wisely, as to each God did deal a measure of faith,
translations.web: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

translations.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
translations.ylt: for as in one body we have many members, and all the members have not the same office,
translations.web: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

translations.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
translations.ylt: so we, the many, one body are in Christ, and members each one of one another.
translations.web: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

translations.kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
translations.ylt: And having gifts, different according to the grace that was given to us; whether prophecy--`According to the proportion of faith!'
translations.web: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

translations.kjv: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
translations.ylt: or ministration--`In the ministration!' or he who is teaching--`In the teaching!'
translations.web: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

translations.kjv: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
translations.ylt: or he who is exhorting--`In the exhortation!' he who is sharing--`In simplicity!' he who is leading--`In diligence?' he who is doing kindness--`In cheerfulness.'
translations.web: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

translations.kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
translations.ylt: The love unfeigned: abhorring the evil; cleaving to the good;
translations.web: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

translations.kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
translations.ylt: in the love of brethren, to one another kindly affectioned: in the honour going before one another;
translations.web: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

translations.kjv: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
translations.ylt: in the diligence not slothful; in the spirit fervent; the Lord serving;
translations.web: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

translations.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
translations.ylt: in the hope rejoicing; in the tribulation enduring; in the prayer persevering;
translations.web: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

translations.kjv: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
translations.ylt: to the necessities of the saints communicating; the hospitality pursuing.
translations.web: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

translations.kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
translations.ylt: Bless those persecuting you; bless, and curse not;
translations.web: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

translations.kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
translations.ylt: to rejoice with the rejoicing, and to weep with the weeping,
translations.web: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

translations.kjv: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
translations.ylt: of the same mind one toward another, not minding the high things, but with the lowly going along; become not wise in your own conceit;
translations.web: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

translations.kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
translations.ylt: giving back to no one evil for evil; providing right things before all men.
translations.web: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

translations.kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
translations.ylt: If possible--so far as in you--with all men being in peace;
translations.web: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

translations.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
translations.ylt: not avenging yourselves, beloved, but give place to the wrath, for it hath been written, `Vengeance is Mine,
translations.web: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

translations.kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
translations.ylt: I will recompense again, saith the Lord;' if, then, thine enemy doth hunger, feed him; if he doth thirst, give him drink; for this doing, coals of fire thou shalt heap upon his head;
translations.web: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

translations.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
translations.ylt: Be not overcome by the evil, but overcome, in the good, the evil.
translations.web: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

translations.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
translations.ylt: Let every soul to the higher authorities be subject, for there is no authority except from God, and the authorities existing are appointed by God,
translations.web: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

translations.kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
translations.ylt: so that he who is setting himself against the authority, against God's ordinance hath resisted; and those resisting, to themselves shall receive judgment.
translations.web: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

translations.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
translations.ylt: For those ruling are not a terror to the good works, but to the evil; and dost thou wish not to be afraid of the authority? that which is good be doing, and thou shalt have praise from it,
translations.web: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

translations.kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
translations.ylt: for of God it is a ministrant to thee for good; and if that which is evil thou mayest do, be fearing, for not in vain doth it bear the sword; for of God it is a ministrant, an avenger for wrath to him who is doing that which is evil.
translations.web: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

translations.kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
translations.ylt: Wherefore it is necessary to be subject, not only because of the wrath, but also because of the conscience,
translations.web: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

translations.kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
translations.ylt: for because of this also pay ye tribute; for servants of God they are, on this very thing attending continually;
translations.web: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

translations.kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
translations.ylt: render, therefore, to all their dues; to whom tribute, the tribute; to whom custom, the custom; to whom fear, the fear; to whom honour, the honour.
translations.web: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

translations.kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
translations.ylt: To no one owe anything, except to love one another; for he who is loving the other--law he hath fulfilled,
translations.web: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

translations.kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
translations.ylt: for, `Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false testimony, Thou shalt not covet;' and if there is any other command, in this word it is summed up, in this: `Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself;'
translations.web: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

translations.kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
translations.ylt: the love to the neighbour doth work no ill; the love, therefore, is the fulness of law.
translations.web: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

translations.kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
translations.ylt: And this, knowing the time, that for us, the hour already is to be aroused out of sleep, for now nearer is our salvation than when we did believe;
translations.web: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

translations.kjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
translations.ylt: the night did advance, and the day came nigh; let us lay aside, therefore, the works of the darkness, and let us put on the armour of the light;
translations.web: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

translations.kjv: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
translations.ylt: as in day-time, let us walk becomingly; not in revellings and drunkennesses, not in chamberings and lasciviousnesses, not in strife and emulation;
translations.web: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

translations.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
translations.ylt: but put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and for the flesh take no forethought--for desires.
translations.web: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

translations.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
translations.ylt: And him who is weak in the faith receive ye--not to determinations of reasonings;
translations.web: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

translations.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
translations.ylt: one doth believe that he may eat all things--and he who is weak doth eat herbs;
translations.web: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

translations.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
translations.ylt: let not him who is eating despise him who is not eating: and let not him who is not eating judge him who is eating, for God did receive him.
translations.web: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

translations.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
translations.ylt: Thou--who art thou that art judging another's domestic? to his own master he doth stand or fall; and he shall be made to stand, for God is able to make him stand.
translations.web: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

translations.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
translations.ylt: One doth judge one day above another, and another doth judge every day alike; let each in his own mind be fully assured.
translations.web: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

translations.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
translations.ylt: He who is regarding the day, to the Lord he doth regard it, and he who is not regarding the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He who is eating, to the Lord he doth eat, for he doth give thanks to God; and he who is not eating, to the Lord he doth not eat, and doth give thanks to God.
translations.web: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

translations.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
translations.ylt: For none of us to himself doth live, and none to himself doth die;
translations.web: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

translations.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
translations.ylt: for both, if we may live, to the Lord we live; if also we may die, to the Lord we die; both then if we may live, also if we may die, we are the Lord's;
translations.web: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

translations.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
translations.ylt: for because of this Christ both died and rose again, and lived again, that both of dead and of living he may be Lord.
translations.web: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

translations.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
translations.ylt: And thou, why dost thou judge thy brother? or again, thou, why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand at the tribunal of the Christ;
translations.web: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

translations.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
translations.ylt: for it hath been written, `I live! saith the Lord--to Me bow shall every knee, and every tongue shall confess to God;'
translations.web: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

translations.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
translations.ylt: so, then, each of us concerning himself shall give reckoning to God;
translations.web: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

translations.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.
translations.ylt: no longer, therefore, may we judge one another, but this judge ye rather, not to put a stumbling-stone before the brother, or an offence.
translations.web: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

translations.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
translations.ylt: I have known, and am persuaded, in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself, except to him who is reckoning anything to be unclean--to that one it is unclean;
translations.web: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

translations.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
translations.ylt: and if through victuals thy brother is grieved, no more dost thou walk according to love; do not with thy victuals destroy that one for whom Christ died.
translations.web: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

translations.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
translations.ylt: Let not, then, your good be evil spoken of,
translations.web: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

translations.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: for the reign of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit;
translations.web: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
translations.ylt: for he who in these things is serving the Christ, is acceptable to God and approved of men.
translations.web: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

translations.kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
translations.ylt: So, then, the things of peace may we pursue, and the things of building up one another;
translations.web: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

translations.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
translations.ylt: for the sake of victuals cast not down the work of God; all things, indeed, are pure, but evil is to the man who is eating through stumbling.
translations.web: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

translations.kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
translations.ylt: Right it is not to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor to do anything in which thy brother doth stumble, or is made to fall, or is weak.
translations.web: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

translations.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
translations.ylt: Thou hast faith! to thyself have it before God; happy is he who is not judging himself in what he doth approve,
translations.web: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

translations.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
translations.ylt: and he who is making a difference, if he may eat, hath been condemned, because it is not of faith; and all that is not of faith is sin.
translations.web: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

translations.kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
translations.ylt: And we ought--we who are strong--to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves;
translations.web: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

translations.kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
translations.ylt: for let each one of us please the neighbour for good, unto edification,
translations.web: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

translations.kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
translations.ylt: for even the Christ did not please himself, but, according as it hath been written, `The reproaches of those reproaching Thee fell upon me;'
translations.web: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

translations.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
translations.ylt: for, as many things as were written before, for our instruction were written before, that through the endurance, and the exhortation of the Writings, we might have the hope.
translations.web: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

translations.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
translations.ylt: And may the God of the endurance, and of the exhortation, give to you to have the same mind toward one another, according to Christ Jesus;
translations.web: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

translations.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: that with one accord--with one mouth--ye may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ;
translations.web: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
translations.ylt: wherefore receive ye one another, according as also the Christ did receive us, to the glory of God.
translations.web: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

translations.kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
translations.ylt: And I say Jesus Christ to have become a ministrant of circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises to the fathers,
translations.web: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

translations.kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
translations.ylt: and the nations for kindness to glorify God, according as it hath been written, `Because of this I will confess to Thee among nations, and to Thy name I will sing praise,'
translations.web: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”

translations.kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
translations.ylt: and again it saith, `Rejoice ye nations, with His people;'
translations.web: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

translations.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
translations.ylt: and again, `Praise the Lord, all ye nations; and laud Him, all ye peoples;'
translations.web: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

translations.kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
translations.ylt: and again, Isaiah saith, `There shall be the root of Jesse, and he who is rising to rule nations--upon him shall nations hope;'
translations.web: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

translations.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: and the God of the hope shall fill you with all joy and peace in the believing, for your abounding in the hope in power of the Holy Spirit.
translations.web: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
translations.ylt: And I am persuaded, my brethren--I myself also--concerning you, that ye yourselves also are full of goodness, having been filled with all knowledge, able also one another to admonish;
translations.web: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
translations.ylt: and the more boldly I did write to you, brethren, in part, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me by God,
translations.web: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

translations.kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: for my being a servant of Jesus Christ to the nations, acting as priest in the good news of God, that the offering up of the nations may become acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
translations.web: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
translations.ylt: I have, then, a boasting in Christ Jesus, in the things pertaining to God,
translations.web: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

translations.kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
translations.ylt: for I will not dare to speak anything of the things that Christ did not work through me, to obedience of nations, by word and deed,
translations.web: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

translations.kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
