translations.ylt: in power of signs and wonders, in power of the Spirit of God; so that I, from Jerusalem, and in a circle as far as Illyricum, have fully preached the good news of the Christ;
translations.web: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

translations.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:
translations.ylt: and so counting it honour to proclaim good news, not where Christ was named--that upon another's foundation I might not build--
translations.web: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

translations.kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
translations.ylt: but according as it hath been written, `To whom it was not told concerning him, they shall see; and they who have not heard, shall understand.'
translations.web: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

translations.kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
translations.ylt: Wherefore, also, I was hindered many times from coming unto you,
translations.web: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

translations.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
translations.ylt: and now, no longer having place in these parts, and having a longing to come unto you for many years,
translations.web: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

translations.kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
translations.ylt: when I may go on to Spain I will come unto you, for I hope in going through, to see you, and by you to be set forward thither, if of you first, in part, I shall be filled.
translations.web: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

translations.kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
translations.ylt: And, now, I go on to Jerusalem, ministering to the saints;
translations.web: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

translations.kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: for it pleased Macedonia and Achaia well to make a certain contribution for the poor of the saints who are in Jerusalem;
translations.web: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
translations.ylt: for it pleased well, and their debtors they are, for if in their spiritual things the nations did participate, they ought also, in the fleshly things, to minister to them.
translations.web: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

translations.kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
translations.ylt: This, then, having finished, and having sealed to them this fruit, I will return through you, to Spain;
translations.web: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

translations.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
translations.ylt: and I have known that coming unto you--in the fulness of the blessing of the good news of Christ I shall come.
translations.web: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

translations.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
translations.ylt: And I call upon you, brethren, through our Lord Jesus Christ, and through the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in the prayers for me unto God,
translations.web: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

translations.kjv: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
translations.ylt: that I may be delivered from those not believing in Judea, and that my ministration, that is for Jerusalem, may become acceptable to the saints;
translations.web: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

translations.kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
translations.ylt: that in joy I may come unto you, through the will of God, and may be refreshed with you,
translations.web: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

translations.kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
translations.ylt: and the God of the peace be with you all. Amen.
translations.web: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

translations.kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
translations.ylt: And I commend you to Phebe our sister--being a ministrant of the assembly that is in Cenchrea--
translations.web: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

translations.kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
translations.ylt: that ye may receive her in the Lord, as doth become saints, and may assist her in whatever matter she may have need of you--for she also became a leader of many, and of myself.
translations.web: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

translations.kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
translations.ylt: Salute Priscilla and Aquilas, my fellow-workmen in Christ Jesus--
translations.web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

translations.kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
translations.ylt: who for my life their own neck did lay down, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the nations--
translations.web: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

translations.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
translations.ylt: and the assembly at their house; salute Epaenetus, my beloved, who is first-fruit of Achaia to Christ.
translations.web: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

translations.kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
translations.ylt: Salute Mary, who did labour much for us;
translations.web: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

translations.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
translations.ylt: salute Andronicus and Junias, my kindred, and my fellow-captives, who are of note among the apostles, who also have been in Christ before me.
translations.web: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

translations.kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
translations.ylt: Salute Amplias, my beloved in the Lord;
translations.web: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

translations.kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
translations.ylt: salute Arbanus, our fellow-workman in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved;
translations.web: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

translations.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.
translations.ylt: salute Apelles, the approved in Christ; salute those of the household of Aristobulus;
translations.web: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

translations.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
translations.ylt: salute Herodion, my kinsman; salute those of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord;
translations.web: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

translations.kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
translations.ylt: salute Tryphaena, and Tryphosa, who are labouring in the Lord; salute Persis, the beloved, who did labour much in the Lord.
translations.web: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

translations.kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
translations.ylt: Salute Rufus, the choice one in the Lord, and his mother and mine,
translations.web: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

translations.kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
translations.ylt: salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren with them;
translations.web: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

translations.kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
translations.ylt: salute Philologus, and Julias, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints with them;
translations.web: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

translations.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
translations.ylt: salute one another in a holy kiss; the assemblies of Christ do salute you.
translations.web: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

translations.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
translations.ylt: And I call upon you, brethren, to mark those who the divisions and the stumbling-blocks, contrary to the teaching that ye did learn, are causing, and turn ye away from them;
translations.web: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

translations.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
translations.ylt: for such our Lord Jesus Christ do not serve, but their own belly; and through the good word and fair speech they deceive the hearts of the harmless,
translations.web: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

translations.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
translations.ylt: for your obedience did reach to all; I rejoice, therefore, as regards you, and I wish you to be wise, indeed, as to the good, and harmless as to the evil;
translations.web: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

translations.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
translations.ylt: and the God of the peace shall bruise the Adversary under your feet quickly; the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen!
translations.web: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

translations.kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
translations.ylt: Salute you do Timotheus, my fellow-workman, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kindred;
translations.web: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

translations.kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
translations.ylt: I Tertius salute you (who wrote the letter) in the Lord;
translations.web: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

translations.kjv: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
translations.ylt: salute you doth Gaius, my host, and of the whole assembly; salute you doth Erastus, the steward of the city, and Quartus the brother,
translations.web: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

translations.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
translations.ylt: the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
translations.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
